body:
Founder real-time blue-sky thread: an abstract, BA-authored affordance language spanning Android native/React Native/Flutter/ratatui via adapters. New docs/UNIVERSAL_UI_NORTHSTAR.md names honestly why this is harder than React Native/Flutter's own single-paradigm story, proposes a 3-layer model (Affordance IR / Capability Model with mandatory explicit degradation / Adapters), grounds it in PARENA's own already-proven multi-target-emitter pattern. Spec-only, no code, no name locked in.

⚓ ☃
title: New Universal UI/Affordance-Language NORTHSTAR -- the frontend half of the platform pitch
